notes.title: BERSERK B.I.T.S DEMO IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! BERSERK B.I.T.S Demo is now live! 
Time for you to grab your B.I.T and PLUG-IN to the Net!

We've included 20 chips to collect and a small segment of the world to explore. 

[u][b]The full game will feature *a lot* more content[/b][/u] and areas to explore, items to collect, bosses to battle and more! 

However we *ARE* actively talking to our community to see what people want, fixing small issues and adding QOL improvements where needed. So if you're interested in sharing your thoughts, come join the discord <3 


We have you have fun with your Personal B.I.T.S Device!

notes.title: New Game Announcement! BERSERK B.I.T.S (Please Wishlist!)
notes.notes:
Plug In!! Download your personal Berserk B.I.T.S!
Train and level up your B.I.T.S (Battle.Intelligent.Teammate.System). Team up with your digital buddy collect battle chips and take on the internet. Battle viruses explore new biomes and defeat powerful bosses!

What is Berserk B.I.T.S?!
Berserk B.I.T.S is an idle-rpg, auto-battler, chip-collecting game that runs on your desktop alongside your other applications. Re-position the game so you can comfortably work and monitor the progress of your B.I.T or minimize it completely and let it go in the background!

[b]And don't worry! - we still have 4 announcements for Berserk Boy before 2024 ends! [/b]

notes.title: Mega Man's best spiritual sequel to date is finally on Steam
notes.notes:
Berserk Boy could very well be one of the best platform games of 2024. There's a lot of year left to go, but the frenetic and fantastic platformer takes what made Mega Man so great and expands upon it, making it a worthy contender. I played the demo at Steam Next Fest and loved it, so if you're a fan of the likes of Sonic Mania, Shovel Knight, and other platformers that revitalize the classic genre, Berserk Boy should be on your radar.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Mega Man has a new spiritual sequel, available to play right now

notes.title: Mega Man has a new spiritual sequel, available to play right now
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is kicking off 2024 with some truly great games, giving you the chance to play a plethora of upcoming releases for free. So platforming fans need to have Berserk Boy on their list. If you're a fan of old-school platformers, Mega Man especially, and want something slick, fast-paced, and incredible sounding, this is for you. There's a bit of Sonic Mania and Shovel Knight in here too, as reimaginings of classic genres continue to prove that developers can reinvent them.

Read the rest of the story...
